channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Logical Take: Open Manholes in India and the Everyday Death of Public Accountability
item.description: India’s open manholes are silently killing citizens every day, exposing systemic negligence and a broken governance framework.

item.title: Managing Transaction Failures in Instant UPI Apps
item.description: A practical guide explaining why UPI payments fail, what to do if money is deducted, and how to resolve disputes quickly and safely.

item.title: Andhra Pradesh: 1 Dead, Over 70 Hospitalised in Srikakulam After Suspected Water Contamination; Civic Chief Suspended
item.description: A suspected municipal water contamination in Srikakulam has left two people dead, nearly 90 hospitalised, and triggered emergency health measures alongside administrative action.

item.title: After Supreme Court’s Strong Objection, NCERT Withdraws Class 8 Textbook Over Judiciary Content; Issues Apology
item.description: Following strong objections from the Supreme Court, NCERT halted distribution of its newly released Class 8 Social Science textbook and initiated retrieval of 38 sold copies, promising a revised edition before the 2026–27 academic session.

item.title: PM Narendra Modi Becomes First World Leader to Cross 100 Million Instagram Followers, Outpacing Global Counterparts
item.description: The Prime Minister’s digital milestone puts him ahead of global leaders, highlighting social media’s growing political influence.

item.title: Beyond Contamination: What Andhra’s ‘Adulterated Milk’ Tragedy Reveals About Food Safety Oversight
item.description: Six deaths in Andhra Pradesh expose deep cracks in India’s informal milk safety oversight system. Everything you need to know.

item.title: 40 Litres Reused Oil, 40 Kg Rotten Tomatoes: McDonald’s Jaipur Faces 14-Day Food Safety Ultimatum
item.description: Jaipur food safety officials seized degraded cooking oil and spoiled produce from a McDonald’s outlet, issuing a 14-day compliance warning.

item.title: “We Feel Your Pain”: PM Modi Reaffirms India’s Firm Stand With Israel After October 7 Terror Attack
item.description: During his address to the Knesset, PM Modi condemned October 7 attack, reiterated solidarity.

item.title: Delhi Horror: Man Allegedly Murders Pregnant Wife, 3 Daughters Over Son Preference, Investigation Underway
item.description: Police in outer North Delhi are searching for the missing husband after a 27-year-old pregnant woman and her three young daughters were found with their throats slit inside their Samaypur Badli residence.

item.title: Bihar Police Bust ‘All India Pregnant Job’ Scam; Gang Promised Over Rs 5 Lakh, Duped Men Nationwide
item.description: Bihar Police have busted a gang. running a fake "pregnant job" scheme, luring men with false promises of cash rewards for impregnating childless women in Nawada.
